# Audit — wayfinder
*Read-understand-gap @ ed37663 · 128 lines · 2026-07-28*

**What:** The heaviest orchestrator: plans work too big for one session as a shared MAP (a tracker issue labelled wayfinder:map) whose child issues are DECISION tickets (resolution = a decision, not a build slice). Map body = Destination / Notes / Decisions-so-far (an INDEX — gist + link, detail lives only in the ticket) / Not-yet-specified (FOG OF WAR: in-scope questions not yet sharp enough to ticket) / Out-of-scope (ruled past the destination; never graduates). Ticket types: research (AFK → /research subagents fired in parallel), prototype (HITL), grilling (HITL, default), task (does rather than decides, only to unblock a decision). Claim-by-assignment before work; blocking via the tracker's NATIVE dependency links (frontier visible in the tracker UI); fog-or-ticket test = can you state the question precisely NOW. Two modes: chart (grill destination → breadth-first frontier → create map+tickets → wire edges second pass → fire research → STOP) and work (load map low-res, claim ONE ticket, resolve, record, graduate fog — never more than one non-research ticket per session).
**Dependencies (max of the set):** tracker "wayfinding operations" from setup (hard); grilling, domain-modeling, research, prototype (conditional). Concurrent-session aware.
**Security:** clean. **Gaps:** none — hierarchy rule and smart-zone are structural here (charting hand-resolves nothing; one ticket per session).
**Audit outcome:** clean; the discipline our graph-engineering ideas should attach to rather than replace.
